target.name: recparse
target.description: RECV1 binary record parser with a stack buffer overflow in the shared payload copy helper

patched.subject: parser: bound payload copy by the destination buffer
patched.author: recparse maintainer <maintainer@recparse.invalid>

tests.note: 24 bytes is comfortably valid; a patch that tightens the limit below 31 breaks here.
Largest payload that fits alongside the NUL terminator.
One past the limit. The release build does not fault here; only the sanitized build does.
Original reproducer, reaches the copy helper through handle_text.
Alternative reproducer, reaches the same helper through handle_raw.

limitations: a position-independent executable does not establish that ASLR is active at run time; that is a property of the kernel and the execution environment, not of the binary
evidence of a stack canary shows the protection is in use somewhere, not that every function is protected; the compiler decides per function
the absence of a mitigation here is a property of this build only, and says nothing about how the project is built elsewhere
